title: The Goa Tillari Irrigation Development Corporation Act, 1999
full_text: The Goa Tillari Irrigation Development Corporation Act, 1999 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 19996 Act Number: 6 Enactment Date: 1999-08-25 Act Year: 1999 Short Title: The Goa Tillari Irrigation Development Corporation Act, 1999 Long Title: to make a special provision for mobilisation of resources for completion of the Tillari Irrigation Project, a joint venture of the Government of Goa and the Government of Maharashtra, in time bound manner and for that purpose to establish the Goa Tillari Irrigation Development Corporation, and for purposes connected with the matters aforesaid. Verma, Principal Secretary (Water Resources), Government of Goa, as the Chairman of the Goa Tillari Irrigation Development Corporation, with immediate effect. 04-05-2017 In pursuance of Clause (a) of sub-section (1) of Section 4 of the Goa Tillari Irrigation Development Corporation Act, 1999 (Goa Act 6 of 1999) and in supersession of the Government Notification No. 4/4/EO-WRD/2014-15/507 dated 17-09-2014, the Government of Goa is pleased to appoint Dr. Ranbir Singh, IAS, Secretary (Water Resources), Government of Goa, as the Chairman of the Goa Tillari Irrigation Development Corporation, with immediate effect. 21-07-2023 Notifications/Order under the provision of the Goa Tillari Irrigation Development Corporation Act, 1999 (Goa Act 6 of 1999) Close × Act NameThe Goa Tillari Irrigation Development Corporation Act, 1999Orders" YearDescriptionHindi DescriptionFiles(Eng)Files(Hindi) Close × Act NameThe Goa Tillari Irrigation Development Corporation Act, 1999Ordinances"YearDescriptionHindi DescriptionFiles(Eng) Files(Hindi) Close × Act NameThe Goa Tillari Irrigation Development Corporation Act, 1999Statutes"YearDescriptionHindi DescriptionFiles(Eng)Files(Hindi) Close
